titration.indication: Depressão maior e ansiedade generalizada (adultos; cápsula de liberação prolongada)
titration.steps: Início: 75 mg/dia em dose única; para alguns, começar com 37,5 mg/dia por 4 a 7 dias antes de subir para 75 mg/dia. Sem resposta, aumentos de até 75 mg/dia em intervalos de pelo menos 4 dias, até o máximo de 225 mg/dia.
titration.note: Nos estudos de eficácia na depressão, os aumentos foram feitos a intervalos de 2 semanas ou mais.

cites.quote: For most patients, the recommended starting dose for Effexor XR is 75 mg per day, administered in a single dose. For some patients, it may be desirable to start at 37.5 mg per day for 4 to 7 days to allow new patients to adjust to the medication before increasing to 75 mg per day.

Patients not responding to the initial 75 mg per day dose may benefit from dose increases to a maximum of 225 mg per day. Dose increases should be in increments of up to 75 mg per day, as needed, and should be made at intervals of not less than 4 days. In the clinical studies establishing efficacy, upward titration was permitted at intervals of 2 weeks or more.

Patients not responding to the initial 75 mg per day dose may benefit from dose increases to a maximum of 225 mg per day. Dose increases should be in increments of up to 75 mg per day, as needed, and should be made at intervals of not less than 4 days.
cites.note: A seção 2.3 repete o início da 2.2 (75 mg/dia, ou 37,5 mg/dia por 4 a 7 dias).

titration.indication: Transtorno de pânico (adultos; cápsula de liberação prolongada)
titration.steps: Início: 37,5 mg/dia por 7 dias; depois, 75 mg/dia. Sem resposta a 75 mg/dia, aumentos de até 75 mg/dia em intervalos de pelo menos 7 dias, até o máximo de cerca de 225 mg/dia.

cites.quote: The recommended starting dose is 37.5 mg per day of Effexor XR for 7 days. Patients not responding to 75 mg per day may benefit from dose increases to a maximum of approximately 225 mg per day. Dose increases should be in increments of up to 75 mg per day, as needed, and should be made at intervals of not less than 7 days.

titration.steps: Redução gradual, sem parada abrupta; nos estudos, a dose diária foi reduzida em 75 mg a intervalos de 1 semana. Pode ser preciso individualizar; em alguns pacientes, a retirada leva vários meses. Se houver sintomas intoleráveis, considerar voltar à dose anterior e depois reduzir mais devagar.
titration.note: A NICE cita a venlafaxina e a paroxetina entre os antidepressivos mais associados a sintomas de retirada, que pedem cuidado especial.

cites.locator: seção 2.10 Discontinuing Treatment with Effexor XR
cites.quote: A gradual reduction in the dose, rather than abrupt cessation, is recommended when discontinuing therapy with Effexor XR. In clinical studies with Effexor XR, tapering was achieved by reducing the daily dose by 75 mg at one-week intervals. Individualization of tapering may be necessary. In some patients, discontinuation may need to occur over a period of several months

If intolerable symptoms occur following a decrease in the dose or upon discontinuation of treatment, then resuming the previously prescribed dose may be considered. Subsequently, the healthcare provider may continue decreasing the dose, but at a more gradual rate.
some commonly used antidepressants such as paroxetine and venlafaxine, are more likely to be associated with withdrawal symptoms, so particular care is needed with them

cite.locator: seção 6.1 Clinical Studies Experience (Most Common Adverse Reactions)
cite.quote: The most commonly observed adverse reactions in the clinical study database in Effexor XR treated patients in MDD, GAD, SAD, and PD (incidence ≥5% and at least twice the rate of placebo) were: nausea (30.0%), somnolence (15.3%), dry mouth (14.8%), sweating (11.4%), abnormal ejaculation (9.9%), anorexia (9.8%), constipation (9.3%), impotence (5.3%), and decreased libido (5.1%).
